name: Kiln
tagline: Two dice rotate the rank wheel; cover your ware to score it before a rival poaches it.
core_loop: Roll two dice to set the heat that rotates every card's fired value; on your turn optionally discard a card to re-roll one die, then fire a hotter card over your own ware (scoring the covered card), poach an opponent's exposed ware, rake your ware back, or gather cards.
win_condition: Highest total of printed ranks in your cabinet plus 5 per suit you hold strictly the most of, when a cabinet hits the threshold, the deck runs out, or the round cap is reached.
